subject: Medford Teachers Association Tentative Agreement
overview: The committee announced a tentative three-year agreement with the Medford Teachers Association and conducted an extensive review of the 2022 MCAS district performance results.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee entered executive session to discuss strategy regarding ongoing collective bargaining with multiple units.

items.title: Consent Agenda and Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Approved the bills, payrolls, and minutes as amended, and received updates on several community grants and upcoming district events.

items.title: Orchestra Donation and Disney Band Trip
items.summary: Accepted a $1,000 donation from the Schmidt family for the orchestra and approved a 2023 performance trip to Disney World using Amtrak to maintain affordability.

items.title: Labor Relations Update
items.summary: Announced a tentative agreement with the Medford Teachers Association involving a three-year contract with cost-of-living increases and changes to the elementary school day schedule.

items.title: 2022 MCAS and MCAS-Alt Results
items.summary: Administrators presented a detailed analysis of state assessment data, identifying learning loss and chronic absenteeism as significant factors while detailing strategies to use NWEA MAP testing for real-time progress monitoring.

items.title: Selection of HECAT Representative
items.summary: Member Paul Ruseau was selected to serve as the committee representative for the Health Education Curriculum Analysis Team.

items.title: Policy Updates and Subcommittees
items.summary: Approved first readings of several financial and administrative policies while referring the budget transfer authority policy to the Rules, Policy, and Equity Subcommittee.

items.title: Suspension and Discipline Report Request
items.summary: The committee discussed a request for demographic data on student discipline, agreeing to refine the request using the ad hoc report procedure for the next meeting.
